author: GitHub
description:
When the cost of error is high, trust is everything. Dan, Director, Senior Corporate Counsel at GitHub, used GitHub Copilot CLI to build a custom skill called Eyeball that embeds inline screenshots of source documents to verify AI analysis. Watch how this tool helps the legal team check complex clauses and act on AI outputs with confidence. Now, every lawyer at GitHub is using the terminal to streamline their daily workflows. Eyeball is open source! Check it out: github.com/dvelton/eyeball
